description: Guest asks about thermostat or wants to change temperature. Real per-unit logic: tell them NOT to use the Nest thermostat, use wall remotes instead. Especially important for certain units.
guestMessage: How do I turn up the heat? It's cold in here.
notes: High value real scenario. Old code had strong 'ignore the Nest' instruction + use heat pump remotes on the wall. Per-unit differences existed.
